project_name: Workplace Safety Sentinel & Hazard Zone Intrusion Detection
track: Track A — PipeGen (Perception) + Closed Loop Bonus
natural_language_prompt: Build an edge vision pipeline with PipeGen to detect workers and PPE compliance (hard hats, safety vests) around automated high-voltage heavy machinery zones. If an unauthorized worker enters a designated red hazard polygon without mandatory PPE, immediately trigger real-time hazard alerts via MQTT (<50ms latency), output a structured JSON incident log with bounding boxes and timestamps, stream video overlay, and command an ESP32 microcontroller over MQTT/Serial to sound an audible alarm, flash red LED strobes, and open the machinery emergency-stop relay.

functional_requirements.title: Real-time Multi-Class Object Detection
functional_requirements.description: Detect persons, hard hats, safety vests, and violations with confidence >= 0.65 at >= 30 FPS.

functional_requirements.title: Hazard Zone ROI Polygon & Line Crossing
functional_requirements.description: Evaluate multi-point convex polygon keep-out zones and detect entry/dwell time using centroid & base-point tracking.

functional_requirements.title: TensorRT Engine Compilation & Quantization
functional_requirements.description: Compile ONNX model to TensorRT 8.6 engine supporting FP16 and INT8 precision with dynamic shapes and calibration cache.

functional_requirements.title: MQTT Real-time Alerting & Incident Telemetry
functional_requirements.description: Broadcast actionable alert JSON payloads to MQTT broker topic 'safety/sentinel/alerts' within 50ms of violation.

functional_requirements.title: Physical AI Actuator Loop via Microcontroller
functional_requirements.description: Deliver trigger signals to ESP32 board over MQTT/Serial to activate physical alarm buzzer, RGB strobe, and safety relay.
